cases.name: valid core.matches insert
cases.expected_result: valid canonical match insert succeeds and an attributable audit event exists

cases.name: duplicate canonical business key
cases.expected_result: duplicate data_date and official_match_no is rejected

cases.name: official market explicitly unavailable
cases.expected_result: snapshot is accepted with UNAVAILABLE and no payload for that market

cases.name: available market without payload
cases.expected_result: write is rejected or retained only as BLOCKED; no fabricated payload is accepted

cases.name: available rqspf without handicap line
cases.expected_result: write is rejected or blocked and no RQSPF selection is created

cases.name: Production engine run after kickoff
cases.expected_result: run is rejected or INVALID and cannot qualify for Tier A or promotion

cases.name: frozen input mutation
cases.expected_result: update after immutable or FROZEN is rejected

cases.name: frozen prediction update or delete
cases.expected_result: update and delete, including a no-op update, are rejected

cases.name: official result correction
cases.expected_result: new result revision with predecessor, reason, and evidence is required; predecessor is unchanged

cases.name: review with mismatched match identity
cases.expected_result: review is rejected or BLOCKED and no valid review exists

cases.name: Tier A pair with different frozen input hashes
cases.expected_result: pair is rejected or permanently ineligible with tier_a_eligible=false

cases.name: Experiment used as forward Tier A member
cases.expected_result: write is rejected or BLOCKED; Experiment never qualifies

cases.name: Shadow or Experiment public projection
cases.expected_result: projection trigger rejects it and public views return no Shadow or Experiment row

cases.name: two active Production revisions
cases.expected_result: second active pointer is rejected by the partial unique rule or activation guard

cases.name: anon or authenticated internal-table write
cases.expected_result: write is denied with the expected privilege failure where applicable

cases.name: approved backend controlled write
cases.expected_result: valid write succeeds only through reviewed grants or functions and critical triggers still run

cases.name: security definer advisor review
cases.expected_result: every security definer has a fixed search_path, actor check, restricted execute, or the finding is BLOCKED

cases.name: canonical latest update business timestamps
cases.expected_result: canonical_latest_update_at equals the maximum real source business timestamp and not page or build time

cases.name: lifecycle audit coverage
cases.expected_result: critical lifecycle events append actor, action, entity, before, after, time, previous hash, and entry hash

cases.name: V3.3.3 boundary before and after comparison
cases.expected_result: no V3.3.3 path, table, row, parameter, output, result, review, sample, or audit history changes
